hook.hook: Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

I love growing garlic because it asks for very little attention in the patch. If you want to know how to grow garlic in the UK, just plant your cloves in full sun. Make sure the soil is well drained so they do not rot.

Do not store raw garlic in oil at room temperature, as there is a risk of botulism.

Check your local frost dates.
